title: Goodnight, Mountain
character: Marlo, a plump young hoary marmot with silver-grey and brown fur, a short bushy tail and small round ears.
palette: fir green, slate blue, ochre, rust, cream snow.
sky: gold alpenglow on the peak → pink → lavender dusk → pale indigo with stars (never black).
cover: Marlo standing up on a boulder in an alpine meadow, a snowy peak behind.
style: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in the style of a vintage national-park screen print: flat overlapping spot colours, simplified geometric shapes for mountains, trees and animals, slight print misregistration and paper grain, a limited palette of five muted colours plus cream, no outlines except where shapes meet, no gradients, no photorealism. Backgrounds are cream with a pale flat sky. Dark colours only for small shapes and accents, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.

pages.text: The sun slides behind the mountain, and the snowy peak glows pink. Marlo the marmot stands up on his rock to look.
pages.beat: Marlo upright on a boulder, pink-lit snowy peak, fir trees.

pages.text: "Time for bed!" whistles Marlo. The whistle bounces off the mountain and comes back.
pages.beat: Marlo whistling, small sound marks echoing off the peak.

pages.text: The black bear and her cub amble back to their den under the roots.
pages.beat: Mother bear and cub walking toward a den beneath a big fir, Marlo watching.

pages.text: The mountain goats settle on a high ledge, white against the grey rock.
pages.beat: Two white mountain goats on a ledge, Marlo far below.

pages.text: The pika stacks his last pile of grass and squeaks goodnight.
pages.beat: Small round pika beside a haystack in the rocks, Marlo beside him.

pages.text: The elk lie down in the meadow, antlers tall against the sky.
pages.beat: Three elk lying in a meadow, lavender sky.

pages.text: The chipmunks scurry into their burrow with cheeks full of seeds.
pages.beat: Two chipmunks at a burrow under a log, Marlo nearby.

pages.text: Down in the creek, the salmon rest in the quiet pools.
pages.beat: Clear creek with two salmon in a still pool, Marlo on the bank.

pages.text: The grey jay tucks her head under her wing in the fir tree.
pages.beat: Grey jay on a fir branch, head tucked, Marlo below.

pages.text: The stars come out over the peak, more and more and more.
pages.beat: Snowy peak with a pale indigo sky full of stars, Marlo small on his rock.

pages.text: Marlo squeezes into the burrow with all his brothers and sisters.
pages.beat: Burrow entrance in the rocks with a pile of sleepy marmots.

pages.text: The whole mountain sleeps under the snow-topped peak. Goodnight, Marlo.
pages.beat: Wide mountain view, meadow, firs, peak, stars, Marlo asleep in the burrow mouth.
